title: Local surjective of the stage presheaf comparison
statement: Let I be a nonempty directed preorder, D : I^op → Scheme a system of qcqs schemes with affine transition morphisms, c a limiting cone, i₀ a fixed index, and G a sheaf of sets on D(i₀) [def-weil-pbc-sets-section-comparison]. On the full affine étale site J of D(i₀) [def-weil-pbc-full-affine-etale-site], let E be any diagram indexed by (Over(op i₀))^op whose objects are the restricted stage push-pull sheaves A_j = (f_j)_* f_j^{-1}G, whose maps are the canonical section comparisons, and let K be a cocone with point L = p_* p^{-1}G and canonical comparison legs. Let Q be the colimit in presheaves of the underlying presheaves of E, and let a : Q → L be the unique presheaf morphism induced by the legs of K. Then a is locally surjective: for every affine étale test object W and t in L(W), the sieve of arrows V → W for which t|V is in the image of a_V is J-covering. This is only the existence part of the comparison; it asserts no uniqueness or equality of representatives.

source.place: Tag 0A35, equation-compute-pullback-to-limit, existence part; affine etale application in Etale Cohomology Tag 09YQ

proof.text: Apply etaleSet_finiteLocalStageRepresentatives to the given limit section on W. Obtain a finite affine stage cover and local sections with the specified comparison images.
Apply etaleSet_eventualLocalStageMatching to that exact family. Obtain a later stage and the base-changed family, still covering and with the same limit images, now compatible.

Glue the compatible family by Presieve.isSheafFor_arrows_iff for the stage inverse-image sheaf. Its comparison target is the continuous pushforward of the limit inverse-image sheaf, hence a sheaf too. Naturality and separatedness on the same stage cover show that the image of the glued section is the prescribed limit section, transported by the iterated-base-change isomorphism. Cancel the isomorphism and unfold etaleSetSheafComparison to identify the result with etaleSetSectionComparison.

For the arbitrary cocone K, use the supplied Arrow equality to transport this representative into E at its stage, including both endpoint equalities. Insert it using colimit.ι. The equation colimit.ι_desc identifies its comparison image with the given section. Thus every comparison component is surjective; apply Presheaf.isLocallySurjective_of_surjective. The object and transition equality hypotheses are not needed because the leg Arrow equalities already contain the endpoint identifications.

proof_origin.place: Tag 0A35, finite local representatives then eventual matching; sheaf gluing, separatedness, endpoint transport, and colimit coprojection assembly proved in Lean

mathlib_searches.query: Local representatives and local eventual equality of sections of inverse images of etale sheaves in limits of schemes
The presheaf colimit of push pull sheaves of sets at stages of a limit of schemes maps locally injectively and locally surjectively to the limit push pull sheaf
mathlib_searches.results: Eight hits include PresheafedSpace.pushforwardDiagramToColimit, colimit_presheaf, and Zariski representability local injectivity. None gives the etale inverse-image limit comparison.

mathlib_searches.query: Presheaf.IsLocallyInjective|Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective; rg stage comparisons in lean/WeilConjectures and lean/Sheaf; blueprint search local representatives and local eventual equality
mathlib_searches.results: Mathlib has the general local comparison and sheafification APIs. Project section continuity and affine eventual equality depend on the current item and cannot be imported (import_direction.py reports the cycle). Blueprint searches return zero exact matches. ColimitSites is stated for Cat.{u,u} and Type u; the affine site presentation uses Cat.{u,u+1} and this coefficient sheaf uses Type (u+1), requiring transport rather than a direct application.

lean.statement:
theorem etaleSetStagePresheaf_locallySurjective
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)] [Nonempty I]
    (D : Iᵒᵖ ⥤ Scheme.{u})
    [∀ i : Iᵒᵖ, CompactSpace (D.obj i)]
    [∀ i : Iᵒᵖ, QuasiSeparatedSpace (D.obj i)]
    [∀ {i j : Iᵒᵖ} (a : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom (D.map a)]
    (c : Cone D) (hc : IsLimit c) (i₀ : I)
    (G : Sheaf (D.obj (op i₀)).smallEtaleTopology (Type (u + 1))) :
    let ρ := (Scheme.fullAffineEtaleInclusion (D.obj (op i₀))).sheafPushforwardContinuous
      (Type (u + 1)) (Scheme.fullAffineEtaleTopology (D.obj (op i₀)))
      (D.obj (op i₀)).smallEtaleTopology
    let A := fun j : Over (op i₀) ↦ ρ.obj
      (((MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ (D.map j.hom)).sheafPushforwardContinuous
        (Type (u + 1)) ((D.obj (op i₀)).smallGrothendieckTopology (P := @Etale) (Q := @Etale))
        ((D.obj j.left).smallGrothendieckTopology (P := @Etale) (Q := @Etale))).obj
          ((Scheme.etaleSetPullback (D.map j.hom)).obj G))
    let L := ρ.obj
      ((@Functor.sheafPushforwardContinuous _ _ _ _
        (MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ (c.π.app (op i₀)))
        (Type (u + 1)) _ ((D.obj (op i₀)).smallGrothendieckTopology (P := @Etale) (Q := @Etale))
        (c.pt.smallGrothendieckTopology (P := @Etale) (Q := @Etale))
        (Etale.isContinuous_overPullback (c.π.app (op i₀)))).obj
          ((Scheme.etaleSetPullback (c.π.app (op i₀))).obj G))
    ∀ (E : (Over (op i₀))ᵒᵖ ⥤
        Sheaf (Scheme.fullAffineEtaleTopology (D.obj (op i₀))) (Type (u + 1)))
      (K : Cocone E),
      (∀ j : Over (op i₀), E.obj (op j) = A j) → K.pt = L →
      (∀ (j k : Over (op i₀)) (a : k ⟶ j)
        (W : (D.obj (op i₀)).FullAffineEtale),
        Arrow.mk ((E.map a.op).hom.app (op W)) =
          Arrow.mk (etaleSetSectionComparison (D.map a.left) (D.map j.hom) (D.map k.hom)
            ((D.map_comp a.left j.hom).symm.trans
              (congrArg (fun t : k.left ⟶ op i₀ ↦ D.map t) a.w)) G W.obj)) →
      (∀ (j : Over (op i₀)) (W : (D.obj (op i₀)).FullAffineEtale),
        Arrow.mk ((K.ι.app (op j)).hom.app (op W)) =
          Arrow.mk (etaleSetSectionComparison (c.π.app j.left) (D.map j.hom)
            (c.π.app (op i₀)) (c.w j.hom) G W.obj)) →
      Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective
      (Scheme.fullAffineEtaleTopology (D.obj (op i₀)))
      (colimit.desc
        (E ⋙ sheafToPresheaf (Scheme.fullAffineEtaleTopology (D.obj (op i₀)))
          (Type (u + 1)))
        ((sheafToPresheaf (Scheme.fullAffineEtaleTopology (D.obj (op i₀)))
          (Type (u + 1))).mapCocone K))
